### New
- **Animated LaMetric icons play.** AWTRIX can only animate icons stored in its memory, so Awtrix Studio now drops animated icons into the clock's `/ICONS` folder the first time they are used (through the clock's web file manager, at the address it reports over MQTT). Static icons are still sent inline. If the clock cannot be reached over HTTP, or its web page is password protected, the first image is shown as before. Files are only ever added, never deleted.
